sources.title: Transnet National Ports Authority Port Statistics
sources.source_statement: The official page states that cargo statistics are based on actual cargo dues invoiced and displays monthly rows through September 2026 with total cargo, TEUs and vessel arrivals. The displayed series' exact geographic aggregation and row definitions must be resolved before corridor use.
permitted_use: Identify official monthly/annual data files and their publisher-side definitions
Build a historical series only after exact artifacts, units and geographic coverage are pinned
prohibited_inference: Do not infer that the displayed figures are Durban-only without a source-backed port identifier
Do not infer design capacity from invoiced cargo or TEUs
Do not infer route-specific rail tonnage from port statistics
required_qualification: Capture exact linked artifacts and SHA-256 digests
Inspect file headers, units, definitions, revisions, coverage and whether values are port-level or aggregate
Reconcile monthly and annual totals; retain missing months and revisions

sources.title: KZN Logistics Hub Programme and Port of Durban Master Plan
sources.source_statement: Transnet describes 33 projects across Durban and Richards Bay masterplans, estimated programme investment above R154 billion, Durban stated current container capacity 2.9m TEUs and planned future capacity 11.4m TEUs.
permitted_use: Record stated capacity/planning claims with status and retrieval date
prohibited_inference: Do not treat planned capacity as commissioned or operating
Do not treat stated capacity as observed throughput or reliable daily service
Do not infer project completion, funding drawdown or permission from a masterplan page
required_qualification: Verify project-level scope, terminal boundary, TEU definitions and revision
Separate current rated, practical, operating, allocated and planned capacities
Check commissioning, funding, permit and service evidence separately

sources.publisher: South African Department of Transport / Government of South Africa
sources.title: Minister of Transport keynote at Africa Rail Convention
sources.source_statement: The speech reports approval of the first 11 private Train Operating Companies on 13 March 2026, expected operations from 1 April 2027 and planned combined freight volume up to 24 million tonnes per year.
permitted_use: Represent approval as a dated policy milestone
Represent expected start and 24 Mt/year as a plan in future scenario branches
prohibited_inference: Do not mark service operational before observed first-service evidence
Do not count the planned 24 Mt/year as current corridor capacity, allocated train paths or actual freight moved
Do not assume routes, commodities or operators have interchangeable capacity
required_qualification: Verify route/section train paths, allocation, contracts and actual service start
Capture operator, commodity, service period, payload and source revision

sources.publisher: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment / Government of South Africa
sources.title: South Africa Climate Change Coastal Adaptation Response Plan launch statement
sources.source_statement: The launch statement describes five components—ecosystems, communities, infrastructure, livelihoods and governance—21 measurable response outcomes and more than 150 interventions.
permitted_use: Define coastal adaptation evidence domains and regional data-gap questions
prohibited_inference: Do not infer a Durban asset's exposure or a funded/completed local intervention from the national statement
Do not treat the launch statement as implementation evidence
required_qualification: Obtain the complete plan and relevant KwaZulu-Natal/municipal plans
Bind intervention to geography, responsible authority, status, budget and monitoring evidence

sources.publisher: South African Department of Water and Sanitation
sources.title: National Water Resource Strategy Third Edition
sources.source_statement: NWRS-3 sets national directions for sustainable/equitable water management, climate adaptation, water quality, ecological infrastructure and water-sector governance.
permitted_use: Define mandatory questions for catchment evidence, rights, water quality, environmental flows and ecological infrastructure
prohibited_inference: Do not infer site-specific allocable surplus, Reserve determination, water-use authorization or transfer feasibility from the national strategy alone
required_qualification: Pin exact PDF bytes and digest
Obtain applicable catchment/Water Management Area data, current balances, Reserve/flow determinations, licensed uses and competent-authority evidence

sources.publisher: South African Department of Transport / Government of South Africa
sources.title: Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System: Final Network Statement and Rail Access Tariffs 2024/2025
sources.source_statement: The government notice links a final network statement and rail access tariffs for 2024/25; TRIM subsequently published Network Statement Version 4 in September 2026.
permitted_use: Retain for historical/policy provenance after exact attachment review
prohibited_inference: Do not use as the current 2026/27 capacity statement or tariff
Do not prefer it over TRIM Network Statement Version 4 or its current annexures
required_qualification: Retain exact old attachment revisions and digest if used for historical comparisons
Use current TRIM Network Statement Version 4 and applicable annexures for 2026/27

sources.title: Final Network Statement Version 4
sources.source_statement: TRIM's official page announces Final Network Statement Version 4 on 18 September 2026 and links Annexures 15, 17, 33, 33a, 33b, 40, 41 and 43. The page also records an updated Annexure 33b capacity statement on 29 October 2026.
permitted_use: Establish current network-statement version and annexure context
Bind the applicability/effective period of the 2026/27 network documents
prohibited_inference: Do not infer route capacity, actual operations or path availability from the landing page alone
Do not equate a published network statement with granted access or dispatched train service
required_qualification: Capture the exact Version 4 PDF and digest
Resolve publication/effective dates, annexure revisions and any later announcements
Bind each capacity/running-time record to the exact annexure version

sources.title: Annexure 33 Network Register, June 2026 v0.3
sources.source_statement: The 8-page register is dated 26 June 2026 and valid under Network Statement Version 4 for the 2026/27 timetable. It identifies General Freight: Johannesburg to Durban as a route and states that Annexure 33b contains section-level theoretical capacity, practical capacity, capacity lost and reasons, operational capacity (daily/weekly), allocated capacity and spare capacity. It notes TRIM infrastructure scope excludes PRASA and other infrastructure managers.
permitted_use: Define route/section vocabulary, network scope, field semantics and validity context
Build a route/section crosswalk only with independently verified source identifiers
prohibited_inference: Do not treat TRIM scope as the entire South African rail system
Do not treat section names or map geometry as current capacity
Do not convert train paths to tonnes without train consist, payload, commodity and service assumptions
required_qualification: Pin exact PDF bytes and digest
Capture section IDs/endpoints and crosswalk provenance
Use the latest Annexure 33b workbook for current values and preserve unresolved/ambiguous section identity

sources.title: Annexure 33a Point-to-Point Running Times and Distances
sources.source_statement: TRIM describes Annexure 33a as station-to-station running times, distances and train frequencies/days for train paths. Annexure 33 warns these times include recovery/buffer time but remain conditional; theft/vandalism and rolling-stock failures may prevent the stated time being achieved.
permitted_use: Use as a dated scheduled/path running-time and distance source after exact workbook capture and parse
prohibited_inference: Do not treat scheduled/buffered time as observed actual transit time or a guarantee
Do not infer route capacity solely from running times
required_qualification: Capture file bytes/digest and terms
Inspect workbook sheets, formulas/cached values, units, validity, route/section identities and frequency definitions
Keep scheduled running times separate from observed transit-time distributions

sources.title: Annexure 33b Capacity Statement, updated 29 October 2026
sources.source_statement: TRIM's official Network Statement page explicitly says Annexure 33b was updated on 29 October 2026. The workbook is the section-by-section capacity source for the Network Register's ten routes, including General Freight Johannesburg–Durban.
permitted_use: After rights/security review and exact capture, parse as the primary source for declared section train-path capacity fields
prohibited_inference: Do not treat linked file as locally acquired, checksum-verified or parsed
Do not execute embedded macros
Do not infer annual freight tonnes from train-path counts without separately sourced train/commodity/payload/service assumptions
required_qualification: Capture exact bytes and SHA-256, verify MIME/file signature and source version
Inspect macro project, hidden/very-hidden sheets, external links, formula cells and cached values without executing macros
Record sheet/cell/range lineage for each normalized value
Reconcile theoretical/practical/lost/operational/allocated/spare semantics with Annexure 33 and preserve any discrepancy
